environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB forwards to instance port 8080. No additional middleware or request filtering. Instance runs the Flask app via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database on local EBS volume.

config.alb: default forwarding rule, no AWS WAF association
